defs.def: to say a poem, piece of literature, etc. that you have learned, especially to an audience （尤指对听众）背诵，吟诵，朗诵

ex.s: Much in the same manner, we may over the years recite to ourselves poems learnt by heart long ago, which have become part of our self-recognition.
ex.t: 当我们交流时，我们传递的是意义。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 提高当地农场的生产力。

ex.s: Why was Addie asked to recite Longfellow’s poem to the Saturday evening’s club?
ex.t: 为什么阿迪被要求在周六晚上的俱乐部上朗诵朗费罗的诗？

defs.def: to say a list or series of things （口头）列举；逐一讲述

ex.s: He will, at a minute’s warning, recite two or three hundred beautifully written verses, with compliments to the listeners!
ex.t: 他能在接到通知后立刻背诵两三百首文笔优美的诗篇，向听众致以赞美！

ex.s: The poems may not make sense and even seem contradictory, but they are easy to learn and recite.
ex.t: 这些诗可能不讲逻辑，甚至看似矛盾，但它们容易学习背诵。

ex.s: What is special is that it is a Chinese poem and that she is able to recite it without an accent.
ex.t: 特别之处在于这是一首中国诗，而且她能够毫无口音地背诵它。

ex.s: When you hear a word that you don’t recognise, don’t panic!
ex.t: 当你听到一个不认识的词时，不要慌张！

ex.s: Maybe you can recognise your own fridge here!
ex.t: 也许你能在这里认出你自己家的冰箱！

ex.s: You do not have to be a fan to recognise the skill of professional players - how they use their bodies to pass, score and defend can be amazing to see - or to fell the excitement of a game ending with a surprising twist.
ex.t: 你不必是球迷也能认识到职业球员的技巧——他们如何运用身体传球、得分和防守，令人叹为观止——或者感受到比赛以惊人转折结束时的兴奋。

ex.s: Feeling the strong emotions of love, anger, fear and grief in the performance, I could easily recognise the theme of Hamlet.
ex.t: 感受到表演中爱、愤怒、恐惧和悲伤的强烈情感，我很容易就能认出《哈姆雷特》的主题。

ex.s: Emotional quotient (EQ), or emotional intelligence quotient, is a measurement of the ability to recognise one’s own and other people’s emotions.
ex.t: 情商（EQ），即情绪智商，是对识别自己和他人情感能力的一种衡量。
